C0696.title: Taobao Misjudgment of Dropshipping Store Leads to Penalty Appeal
C0696.summary: A Taobao merchant was penalized after the platform flagged the store as a dropshipping store, resulting in the confiscation of the consumer protection deposit, product delisting, and listing restrictions.
